desc: Ideation and reduction: answer(x) = largest divisor d of x with cnt[d] >= K, where cnt[d] = count of elements divisible by d
Build freq array and M using fast IO (single sys.stdin.buffer.read)
Compute cnt[d] for all d via prime-based descending superset sum (primes from sieve)
Compute g[d] = max-over-divisors of (d if cnt[d]>=K else 0) via ascending prime loop
Add K==1 shortcut and M==1 / all-equal edge-case handling
Output g[A_i] for each i with joined string; verify samples 1,2,3 and edge cases
